title: MoE Ethiopian Exit Exam: Marketing Management (2015)
description: Official Ministry of Education (MoE) Ethiopian University Exit Examination for Marketing Management (2015). Complete with detailed explanations.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements best explain branding?
options: It is the function of naming new products
It focuses on the physical and tangible attributes of a product
It is the process of building favorable perceptions about a brand
It is the process of creating products that satisfy customers' needs
questions.explanation: Branding is primarily about creating favorable perceptions about a brand in consumers' minds. It involves developing a unique identity, values, and associations that differentiate the brand from competitors.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is among the primary objectives of conducting market analysis?
options: To learn the stakeholders in the market
To identify the competitors in the market
To understand the dynamic trends in the market
questions.explanation: Understanding dynamic trends is crucial for effective market analysis.

questions.questionText: A type of sales manager style that supports their sales team members through every step, from prospecting to closing deals.
questions.explanation: Coaching style involves supporting team members throughout the sales process.

questions.questionText: _____ is associated with the purchase, use and disposal of goods and services and includes consumers' emotional, mental and behavioral activities.
questions.explanation: Consumer behavior encompasses all activities related to goods and services including purchase decisions, usage patterns, and post-purchase behavior. It also includes the psychological and social aspects of consumption.

questions.questionText: Since strategic marketing management requires firms to assess their environment and take proactive decisions to exploit opportunities, hence strategic marketing management involves:
questions.explanation: Strategic marketing management is multidisciplinary in nature.

questions.questionText: What is the main advantage associated with geographic based sales organization structure?
options: Greater attention given to new products
questions.explanation: Geographic structures allow for better knowledge of local applications.

questions.questionText: Identify the program multiplier that does not belong to marketing program investment:
questions.explanation: Redundancy does not contribute positively to marketing program investment.

questions.questionText: Types of E-business that involve a manufacturer and wholesaler, or a wholesaler and a retailer is:
questions.explanation: B2B involves transactions between businesses, such as manufacturers and wholesalers.

questions.questionText: A movie theatre offering 4 sessions during the month of June for 200 Birr is an example of:
questions.explanation: Multiple-use price discounts provide a reduced price for multiple uses or visits, like a discounted package for multiple movie sessions. Yield management involves adjusting prices based on demand and capacity, which isn't specified in this example.

questions.questionText: If in a given market there are four manufacturers who contact four retailers directly, determine the number of contacts needed for all manufacturers to contact all retailers.
questions.explanation: With 4 manufacturers each contacting 4 retailers, the total number of contacts is 4 × 4 = 16 contacts.

questions.questionText: Business-to-consumer (B2C) e-commerce, in which online businesses seek to reach individual consumers, is the most well-known and familiar type of e-commerce. Which of the following is NOT a B2C business model?
questions.explanation: E-distributors primarily serve businesses, not consumers.

questions.questionText: IBM, which offers many hardware and software variations to different segments in the computer market is a good example of:
questions.explanation: IBM uses a differentiated strategy to cater to various market segments.

questions.questionText: Customers who are more likely to engage in negative word of mouth to friends and relatives and switch providers than are others with an average propensity to complain to the provider.
questions.explanation: Irates are customers who express dissatisfaction vocally.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement is correct?
options: At the decline stage of the product lifecycle sales has leveled off
At the maturity stage of the product lifecycle sales reach peak
At the growth stage of the product lifecycle sales is declining
At the growth stage of the product lifecycle sales is stagnant
questions.explanation: Sales peak during the maturity stage of the product lifecycle.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a necessary reason driving firms to go for international marketing?
questions.explanation: Inflation and price moderation are not primary drivers for international marketing.

questions.questionText: If a firm is NOT directly engaged in any form of international marketing but still its products are sold indirectly in foreign market, the firm is said to be in the _____ stage of international marketing.
questions.explanation: No direct foreign marketing indicates indirect sales in foreign markets.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following CANNOT be considered as a brand element?
questions.explanation: Price is not a brand element; it is a marketing strategy.

questions.questionText: A poultry brand named 'Kukulull' using the image of a fancy chicken is applying the secondary brand association through:
questions.explanation: Using a character image is a form of secondary brand association.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true about structured interview?
options: It is more reliable than unstructured interview
It gives interviewers more power in deciding on the order and format of questions to ask during interview
It is less reliable than unstructured interview
It varies question form and type for each applicant
questions.explanation: Structured interviews are generally more reliable due to their consistency.

questions.questionText: Which of the following industrial products require significant financial expenditure so that marketers may have to extend credit to the buyer, assist the buyer in securing funds or loans, or offer the buyer leasing agreements?
questions.explanation: Capital equipment often requires significant financial arrangements.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following cannot be an instance for diversification strategy?
options: Food processing firm entering into computer maintenance business
furniture manufacturing company entering into real estate business
questions.explanation: A bakery starting a pastry business is not diversification but rather product line extension, as pastries are closely related to the existing bakery business. The other options represent true diversification into unrelated business areas.

questions.questionText: A type of sampling approach in which the researcher asks respondents to provide the names of additional respondents is:
questions.explanation: Snowball sampling relies on referrals to gather more respondents.

questions.questionText: Which of the following type of promotion mix is an interactive process where responses from buyers are recorded in a database for building profiles of potential customers and providing valuable marketing information for more efficient targeting?
questions.explanation: Direct marketing involves interaction and data collection for targeting.

questions.questionText: When a customer develops attitude towards a given brand as a result of prior knowledge of the brand, his attitude is said to be primarily influenced by the ____ component of attitude?
questions.explanation: The cognitive component is based on prior knowledge and beliefs.

questions.questionText: The dominant method of distributing convenience products is:
questions.explanation: Intensive distribution aims to provide convenience products widely.

questions.questionText: The microenvironment consists of:
questions.explanation: The competitive environment is a key aspect of the microenvironment.

questions.questionText: Building personal relationships with customers in such a way that the health club or restaurant manager knows her customers personally; or the private school principal knows the students' parents, and a bank manager knows the customers' business and financing history and requirements helps to provide:
questions.explanation: Personal relationships foster social benefits for customers.

questions.questionText: According to the gaps model of service quality, which of the following gaps is the difference between the service actually delivered by frontline service personnel on a day-to-day basis and the specifications set by management?
questions.explanation: Gap 3 represents the difference between service delivery and management specifications.

questions.questionText: Among the function of selling the process of reaching some point of common understanding through offers and counter offers is known as:
questions.explanation: Negotiations involve reaching mutual understanding through offers.

questions.questionText: ______ is the coordination of all marketing communication tools, avenues, and sources within a company into a seamless program that maximizes the impact on consumers and other end users at a minimal cost.
questions.explanation: Integrated marketing communication ensures a cohesive marketing message.

questions.questionText: Which segmentation level is appropriate when customers have clustered preferences as in the automobile industry rather than diffused or homogenous preferences?
questions.explanation: Segment marketing targets groups with similar preferences.

questions.questionText: In Ethiopian culture, communications are indirect and the context of the message is more important than the words in conveying meaning. Such kind of cultures is considered as______ in international marketing environment.
questions.explanation: High context cultures rely on indirect communication.

questions.questionText: One of the key characteristics of consumer behavior is that it is_______
questions.explanation: Consumer behavior is driven by various motivations.

questions.questionText: Identify the correct statement.
options: Market offerings are limited to physical products
Market offerings do not include services
Market offerings may include products with intangible attributes
Market offerings exclude entities, such as persons, places, organizations, information, and ideas
questions.explanation: Market offerings can include both tangible and intangible products.

questions.questionText: Which of the following involves marketing of products and services to organizations rather than to households or ultimate consumers?
questions.explanation: Business marketing targets organizations rather than individual consumers.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement is NOT correct?
options: The dominant form of distributing shopping goods is direct
The less dense the market, the more likely it is that intermediaries will be used.
form of indirect distribution is when firms sell via wholesalers
If the market is large, the use of intermediaries is more likely to be needed because of the high transaction costs of serving large numbers of individual customers.
questions.explanation: Shopping goods are typically distributed through indirect channels.

questions.questionText: Which of the following contracts provides the holder of the contract the right but NOT the obligation to buy or sell?
questions.explanation: An option contract gives the right without obligation.

questions.questionText: Science is based on the assumption that all events have antecedent causes that are subject to identification and logical understanding. This characteristic of science is:
questions.explanation: Deterministic means events can be predicted based on causes.

questions.questionText: Assuming that sales forecasted for 2023 for Coffee was 18,000 quintals per year and actual sales for coffee was 15,000 quintals and smoothing constant of 0.70, what will be sales forecasted for the year 2024?
questions.explanation: Using the formula, the forecasted sales for 2024 is 15750.

questions.questionText: _____ of transportation is the time required to complete a specific movement.
questions.explanation: Speed refers to the time taken for transportation.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an operational definition of the construct - demographics?
options: The percent that bought the product
How old, what gender, and so on of the respondents
Percent of respondents having heard of brand
The number who knows about a product
questions.explanation: Demographics refer to characteristics like age and gender.

questions.questionText: Since employee satisfaction and customer satisfaction are inextricably linked, service providers must be enabled with the required levels of skills, abilities, tools, and motivation. This is a reflection of:
questions.explanation: Internal marketing focuses on employee satisfaction to enhance customer service.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a typical characteristic of agricultural products?
questions.explanation: Agricultural products are typically inelastic in supply.

questions.questionText: Identify the wrong statement regarding characteristics of strategic management.
options: It assumes the future as duplication of the past
questions.explanation: Strategic management does not assume the future will duplicate the past.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the first step in the personal selling process?
questions.explanation: Prospecting is the initial step in personal selling.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is paid form of non-personal communication by an identified sponsor?
questions.explanation: Advertising is a paid form of communication.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a qualitative technique of making a forecast?
questions.explanation: Time series analysis is a quantitative forecasting technique.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the advantage of using a focus group research?
options: Participants of a focus group may represent the general population
Interpretation of data from focus group is objective
They work well with special respondents
The cost per participant is low in case of focus groups
questions.explanation: Focus groups work well with special respondents as they allow for in-depth discussions and provide rich qualitative data from specialized groups. Focus groups typically don't represent the general population due to their small size and selective recruitment.

questions.questionText: Safe and reliable transportation provided by a rail travel service, career enhancement opportunity provided by a higher learning institution, and rest and recuperation provided by a hotel are examples of:
questions.explanation: These are examples of service as core product, where the primary offering is the service itself rather than a physical product. Transportation, education, and accommodation are fundamental service products that directly address customer needs.

questions.questionText: Which of the following livestock and meat marketing functions brings together cattle for slaughter, for fattening, or for breeding herds?
questions.explanation: Assembly involves gathering livestock for various purposes.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is correct?
options: speculator with a bearish view will take a long position in the market
speculator with a bullish market view will take a short position in the market.
speculator with a bearish view will buy commodities in the market
speculator with a bullish market view will take a long position in the market.
questions.explanation: Bullish speculators expect prices to rise and take long positions.

questions.questionText: If you are required to prepare the documentation for the export of animal and food products you would process sanitary and health inspection of the export items and get:
questions.explanation: A quarantine certificate is necessary for exporting food products.

questions.questionText: If a brewery brand introduces nonalcoholic drink to enter in a country that does NOT allow the production of alcoholic drinks, it is trying to comply with:
questions.explanation: Legal requirements dictate compliance with local laws.

questions.questionText: According to the value perspective of a brand, ____ value refers to the psychological aspect of the customer, what they want to reveal to others through a brand.
questions.explanation: Expressive value relates to how customers perceive themselves through brands.

questions.questionText: Extra net are:
options: Any individual with dial-up access or LAN
Limited to information pertinent to the company, often proprietary and sensitive information
questions.explanation: Extra nets are used for authorized groups in business collaborations.

questions.questionText: Brands like Philips and Sony use the same brand for their product lines and are good examples of:
questions.explanation: Family branding involves using the same brand name across multiple products.

questions.questionText: When we frame research in terms of the hierarchy of effects model, one hierarchy is awareness, the right research question to formulate for awareness is:
options: What percent of the market have positive, negative, or neutral attitudes towards your brand?
What percent of the market intends to buy your brand the next time they purchase the product?
What percent of the market purchased your brand in the past?
What percent of the market has heard of your brand?
questions.explanation: Awareness research focuses on brand recognition.

questions.questionText: The abilities to perform a specialized task that involves a certain method of process.
questions.explanation: Technical skills are necessary for specialized tasks.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a level of market segmentation known as the 'shotgun' approach where firms are scattering their marketing efforts to unidentified or unclassified market?
questions.explanation: Mass marketing targets a broad audience without specific segmentation.

questions.questionText: An international market entry mode more suitable for mineral explorations under the contract to construct facility, provide technology, train staff and hand over the undertaking to the client is_____
questions.explanation: Turnkey projects involve complete transfer of operations to the client.

questions.questionText: This exists whenever one participant in a market has more resources than other participants.
questions.explanation: Asymmetry refers to unequal resource distribution in a market.

questions.questionText: Consumers feel shy to make some purchases in public hence marketers facilitate their purchase information to be private / confidential. Which of the following characteristics of consumers' motivation best explains this practice?
options: Consumers desire order in their world
questions.explanation: Hidden motives can lead to a desire for privacy in purchases.

questions.questionText: If a customer at age 65 develops negative attitude towards an amusement park favored by youngsters, which of the below attitude functions best demonstrate the attitude formation in this case?
questions.explanation: Ego defense function is when attitudes protect one's self-image. An older person avoiding youth-oriented activities may be protecting their self-concept and social identity, making this an ego defense rather than specifically age-related.

questions.questionText: The service quality dimension which measures the ability to perform the promised service dependably and accurately.
questions.explanation: Reliability is about delivering promised services consistently.

questions.questionText: Which of the following terms describes the nature of relationship and the extent to which customers feel attached to the brand?
questions.explanation: Brand resonance reflects customer attachment and loyalty.

questions.questionText: Which element of the marketing mix is directly related to channel management?
questions.explanation: Place refers to distribution channels in the marketing mix.

questions.questionText: Chevrolet, an American car brand while trying to enter into Middle East market, assessed the need to customize its cars' engines to sustain the hot weather in the region. Chevrolet is trying to comply with:
questions.explanation: Climatic requirements necessitate product adaptation to local conditions.

questions.questionText: How does purchase timing and complexity influence consumer behavior?
options: If the purchase decision is simple customers take significant time to consume the product
When customers have short time for purchase they are involved in large number of processes
When customers make complex purchases they are involved in lots of processes
The shorter the timing the more complex the consumer behavior
questions.explanation: Complex purchases require more decision-making processes.

questions.questionText: In modern personal selling, organizations emphasis is on:
questions.explanation: Modern selling focuses on customer relationships and satisfaction.

questions.questionText: The number of levels in a channel can NOT be:
options: One level - which is the most direct (manufacturer user)
Four level which involves two intermediaries
Two levels - which is the most direct (manufacturer user)
Three level - which involves one intermediary
questions.explanation: Two levels cannot be the most direct channel because a direct channel (manufacturer to user) has only one level - the zero level channel. Two-level channels involve one intermediary, making them indirect.

questions.questionText: Assume you are just hired as a marketing manager for a given firm and the CEO requested you to identify the strategic group of the firm. What criteria do you use to do the same?
options: Firms producing similar product line and adopting diversification strategy
Firms producing similar products, selling to the same market, at similar range of prices and have similar assets
Firms producing any products and selling on the same price range like ours
Firms operating in the same geographic market and having similar distribution strategies
questions.explanation: Strategic groups are identified by similar market and pricing strategies.

questions.questionText: When a TV commercial interrupts a person while he is watching a football game, the commercial is said to be causing_______.
questions.explanation: Involuntary attention occurs when a commercial interrupts an ongoing activity.

questions.questionText: Which of the following business product lines are different variations of accessories and option to complement the proprietary or catalog products offered?
questions.explanation: Custom built products are often variations of standard offerings with modifications to meet specific customer needs, functioning as accessories or options to complement core product lines.

questions.questionText: Which of the following type of advertising includes messages directed at retailers, wholesalers, and distributors, as well as industrial purchasers?
questions.explanation: Business-to-business advertising targets other businesses and intermediaries.

questions.questionText: In which of the following price discovery systems does the system shift the locus of price discovery from the farm gate to a public market place where all buyers and sellers and their supplies and demands are represented?
questions.explanation: Organized market trading facilitates price discovery in a public setting.

questions.questionText: A car assembly company in Ethiopia advertises the benefits of the newly assembled automobiles in terms of its fuel consumption, availability of spare parts, after sales services, and fair price value propositions. What type of advertising appeal is used by the company?
questions.explanation: Rational appeal focuses on logical benefits and value propositions.

questions.questionText: Given the following linear equation, y = a + bx, where x is the result of an aptitude test and y is the job performance, then aptitude test has:
options: An unknown effect on job performance
questions.explanation: From the equation y = a + bx, we cannot determine whether the aptitude test has a positive or negative effect on job performance without knowing the sign of coefficient b. If b is positive, the effect is positive; if b is negative, the effect is negative.

questions.questionText: _____ of transportation is the time required to complete a specific movement.
questions.explanation: Speed refers to the time taken for transportation.

questions.explanation: These services enhance the core product offering.
